headline_pain: Can You Buy a Warehouse via SMSF?
primary_text: "Can I actually buy a warehouse through my super? The rules seem complicated." Short answer: yes, you can. SMSFs can purchase commercial property — and you can lease it back to your own business. It's one of the smartest strategies for small business owners, but the rules need to be followed precisely. Our team connects you with SMSF specialists who handle commercial property purchases every day. New off-the-plan warehouses in Truganina, 20km from Melbourne CBD. Princes Freeway access. Get the facts on SMSF warehouse purchases — no obligation.
description: SMSF specialist guidance for buying commercial property through your super fund
